# Make Blur

> **How to Blur Photo** (website brand: **Make Blur**) is a free iOS photo editor in Graphics & Design for blurring photo backgrounds and faces on iPhone after you shoot. It uses on-device subject detection. It is not a background-removal (transparent PNG) tool and not a video editor.

## Key Facts (App Store, September 2026)

- App Store name: How to Blur Photo
- Subtitle: Sharp Subject, Soft Focus
- App Store ID: 6749166426
- URL: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749166426
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18.6 or later
- Price: Free to download; optional in-app purchases for advanced styles and tools
- Processing: On-device; photos are not uploaded when you blur backgrounds
- Size: 25.7 MB
- Languages: English + 30 more
- Rating: 3.0 from 2 ratings — too few to treat as social proof
- Website: https://makeblur.com

## What users ask

- How to blur background on iPhone after capture (not only Portrait mode) → https://makeblur.com/how-to-blur-background-on-iphone.html
- Blur background of a photo → https://makeblur.com/blur-background-of-photo.html
- How to blur faces in a photo (no Apple Intelligence required) → https://makeblur.com/how-to-blur-faces-in-a-photo.html
- Motion blur effect on still photos → https://makeblur.com/motion-blur-effect.html
- Gaussian blur on iPhone → https://makeblur.com/gaussian-blur-iphone.html

## Main sections

- Landing: after-you-shoot background blur, App Store download, listing screenshots
- Guides: one URL per converting keyword
- FAQ: question-level answers with Learn more into guides
- Limited online editor: full-image blur only (not selective background blur)
